company.name: Multiverse
company.shortDescription: Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.
company.description:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption. Multiverse has partnered with over 1,500 companies in the US & UK to deliver a new kind of learning that’s transforming the workforce through tech skills.

Multiverse apprenticeships are for people of any age or career stage and focus on critical AI, data and tech skills. Multiverse learners have driven $2bn + ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

productsAndServices.description: An employer-focused platform and service for diagnosing workforce skills gaps and delivering AI, data, technology, and leadership training through structured learning programmes.
productsAndServices.name: Multiverse Upskilling Platform

productsAndServices.description: Structured workplace training programmes that develop practical AI, data, digital, engineering, and leadership skills while employees continue working in their organisations.
productsAndServices.name: Professional Apprenticeships

productsAndServices.description: An assessment service that compares organisational goals with current employee capabilities to identify priority skills gaps and recommend targeted learning pathways.
productsAndServices.name: Skills Gap Assessment and Workforce Skills Strategy

productsAndServices.description: A Level 4 apprenticeship programme that teaches junior and mid-level professionals to select and implement AI solutions linked to measurable business outcomes.
productsAndServices.name: AI for Business Value

productsAndServices.description: A Level 3 apprenticeship programme that develops practical generative AI and digital support skills, including responsible use of tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Gemini.
productsAndServices.name: AI-Powered Productivity

productsAndServices.description: A data skills apprenticeship programme that helps employees use data for analysis, interpretation, and informed business decisions.
productsAndServices.name: Data & Insights For Business Decisions
